snippet.title: Antimatter - A 4x Sandbox Game and RPG in Space - Dev Trailer
snippet.description:
Antimatter is a 4x strategy game and RPG in space.
It features the exploration of procedurally generated galaxies, simulating thousands of colonizable planets.
Customize your ship and participate to combat across millions of kilometers or in interstellar space.
Get involved in more or less honest trade ventures across the galaxy.
Meddle with intricate interplanetary politics.

The game is still in development two years after a successful Kickstarter campaign. (https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/geopi/antimatter-a-city-builder-and-4x-game?lang=fr)

It is a work of passion from a solo developer.
------------
* Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343010/Antimatter/
* Join the (small) community and get updated on any progress: https://discord.com/invite/2v42fgS
